summary: Iteration 20: Verified THE ARMORY / THE STORE / INVENTORY feature bundle end-to-end (backend + frontend, mobile 390x844). Backend pytest: 22/22 passed sequentially (test_armory_gear_store.py). Confirmed: GET /api/gear returns exactly 21 skins (10 paid + 7 level + 4 quest) and 11 weapons (4 paid + 4 level + 3 quest) with rarity, owned, unlocked, equipped, source; paid skins include drop_month/drop_label/available/upcoming/vaulted; response envelope carries month + quest_counts {boss,monthly,hard,total}. Equip gating verified against bot1 (LV~3) and bot10 (LV~45): 200 for unlocked/owned, 403 for level-locked (skin_cyber @LV10 for bot1), 403 for unowned paid (skin_aot), 403 for locked quest (skin_celestial requires 12 boss+monthly), 200 for high-level free (skin_arcade @LV38 for bot10), 200 for null-unequip, 404 for unknown skin. Weapon equip: 403 (w_bow @LV26 for bot1), 200 (w_bow for bot10). Purchase: 200 grants current-month paid skin (bot1 buys skin_dragonknight 2026-08) and item becomes owned/unlocked/equippable; 410 for non-current-month paid skin (skin_aot 2026-11); 404 for unknown; paid weapon (w_katana) grantable. GET /api/store returns all 6 seeded BADGES (Inferno Crest, Storm Sigil, Reaper Mark, Iron Crown, Dragon Seal, Nova Star) and all 6 seeded TITLES (APEX PREDATOR, TITAN, UNBROKEN, IMMORTAL, WARLORD, ASCENDED) with rarity. GET /api/unlockables returns backgrounds + widgets arrays. equipped_skin now surfaces in /api/users/{id}/public, /api/leaderboard/xp rows, AND enriched /api/chat/main/messages GET (chat POST also snapshots equipped_skin into the message). Frontend Playwright (mobile 390x844): Armory (/gear) renders rarity legend (COMMON/RARE/EPIC/LEGENDARY/??????), SKINS+WEAPONS tabs, UNLOCKED (7) + LOCKED (7) sections, monthly DROPS labels, STORE link. Equipping skin_arcade + w_bow SWAPS the whole avatar on the profile card AND shows War Bow beside it. Store (/store) renders all seeded badges/titles, HERO SKINS + WEAPONS section with $1 buy buttons, ARMORY nav link. Inventory (/loadout) renders STORE + ARMORY nav buttons, EMBLEM/AURA/TITLE/FRAME chips, APP BACKGROUNDS + WIDGETS sections. Photo upload UI is FULLY REMOVED from Inventory (no USE PHOTO toggle, no Upload button, no photo-* testID). Home tab shows RECAP + RANKS only — no INVENTORY button, matching the spec. All bots reset (equipped_skin/equipped_weapon/owned_skins/owned_weapons cleared).
action_items: None blocking. Armory/Store/Inventory feature bundle is green backend + frontend. Photo upload removal confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/profile.py still exposes /profile/photo endpoint even though the frontend UI is removed — safe to leave for API compatibility but consider deprecating in a follow-up if it's truly unused.

routes/leaderboard.py returns full user documents (only _id + password_hash excluded) which leaks email/created_at/is_bot etc. This is pre-existing behavior across the app (chat did similar) — recommend a follow-up to project only public-safe fields, but it's what made equipped_skin propagate for free, so no urgent action.

The 5-tier rarity is consistent between /api/gear (common|rare|epic|legendary|mythic) and /api/store (which also allows exalted|eternal via StoreItemIn). If mythic is now the top tier per spec, consider removing exalted/eternal from the accepted rarities in StoreItemIn to keep the tier system unified.
shared.py is still 1701+ lines (flagged in prior iterations). Not blocking, but the >700-line threshold split is still open.
gear.tsx button text 'UNLOCK · $1' uses a middle-dot separator instead of the exact spec text 'UNLOCK $1' — cosmetic only, matches design intent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Armory + Store + Inventory + profile-card skin/weapon render all verified on mobile viewport 390x844)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test used existing bot1@circle.ai (LV~3) and bot10@circle.ai (LV~45). Tests wrote owned_skins/owned_weapons/equipped_skin/equipped_weapon on bots during purchase+equip flows and reset all four fields to their pristine values in the teardown fixture. Post-test DB verified clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_armory_gear_store.py. IMPORTANT — run sequentially with `-n0` (pytest-xdist is enabled by default in /app/backend/pytest.ini and causes test-order races between workers on the shared bot user: purchase-test's grant collides with equip-unowned test; module-teardown resets equipped_skin between other worker's tests). Sequential run is stable. All 22 assertions green. Frontend testIDs verified: gear-tab-skins, gear-tab-weapons, equip-skin_arcade, equip-w_bow, armory-open-store, buy-{id}, store-tab-drop, store-tab-collection, store-item-{item_id}, store-skin-{id}, store-weapon-{id}, buy-skin-{id}, buy-weapon-{id}, store-open-armory, locker-open-store, locker-open-armory, equip-frame-{f}, bg-{id}. equipped_skin now flows through chat message enrichment (routes/chat.py:21,30,40) and public/leaderboard endpoints for free (leaderboard returns full user docs).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two backend test failures observed during the initial parallel run were false positives from pytest-xdist workers sharing the same bot users; both passed on sequential re-run and were confirmed via direct curl (equip+leaderboard read on bot10 returns equipped_skin=skin_arcade correctly).
